reasoning: Checks the unchecked Skill Visionary — Katelijne's reputation as Bruges' harmless mad clockmaker deflects suspicion. Mute Ilya, unable to speak in his own defense, is arrested in her place. Decades have now passed since Ragusa without a mortal dying of old age (refs/rules.txt:155), so Beatriz is struck out here as overdue background upkeep, which also empties her Memory — forgotten to make room for this turn's new one, since all five are full.

operations.description: a mute boy Dragan sent to me; taken by the watch in my place, unable to speak a word to clear himself

operations.text: Decades gone, Beatriz finally dies old and gray in her own bed while I sleep away the day; that same week the watch comes asking after bloodless corpses near my workshop, and it is mute Ilya — who cannot speak to clear himself — that I let them take instead, my name as Bruges' harmless mad clockmaker sparing me entirely.
